headline: Weathered Expanse Roars On as Nevish Line and Stlican Shelf Shift
war_summary: Fighting runs unchecked in the Weathered Expanse, where the line holds at four Warden posts against five Colonial and forty events have been logged in the past day, three of them inside the last two hours. Two sectors have shifted since the previous edition. Nevish Line now reads five Warden posts to three Colonial, the Colonials having recovered ground, and Stlican Shelf reports two posts ruined and unclaimed alongside five Colonial and two Warden. Callahan's Passage holds at eight Warden to two Colonial but has gone quiet, with no events in the last two hours and its latest recorded before noon. Stonecradle stands at seven Colonial to two Warden. Linn Mercy remains wholly Colonial at eleven posts and Mooring County wholly Warden at twelve, both comparatively still. Twelve events were filed map-wide in the past two hours: six on Stlican Shelf, three in the Weathered Expanse and three on Nevish Line. Casualty ledgers run heaviest in the Weathered Expanse, Nevish Line, Stonecradle, Stlican Shelf and Callahan's Passage. No victor has been declared.
